bugs.test: get watchlist returns movies in order added
bugs.why: getWatchlist calls Watchlist.findByUser(), which doesn't exist, so the list always fails with 500
bugs.fix: Query the user's entries in the order they were added and populate the movies: Watchlist.find({ user: userId }).sort({ createdAt: 1, _id: 1 }).populate('movie').

bugs.test: add movie creates entry and rejects duplicates
bugs.why: addToWatchlist answers 201 but never saves the entry, and never checks for duplicates
bugs.fix: Answer 400 "Movie already in watchlist" when an entry exists, otherwise Watchlist.create(...). Error code 11000 from the unique index is only a safety net.

bugs.test: remove movie deletes entry and 404 when missing
bugs.why: removeFromWatchlist never deletes anything and never answers 404
bugs.fix: Watchlist.findOneAndDelete({ user: userId, movie: movieId }), then 404 "Movie not found in watchlist" when nothing was deleted.

bugs.why: checkWatchlistStatus returns the array from find() instead of true / false

edits.fixed: const entry = await Watchlist.findOne({ user: userId, movie: movieId });
edits.buggy: const isInWatchlist = await Watchlist.find({ user: userId, movie: movieId });

bugs.test: rate limit window slides after two minutes
bugs.why: watchlistRateLimiter is broken: windowMs is never defined, the filter keeps the expired timestamps (>= instead of <), `if (requests)` is always true (an empty array is truthy), and validRequests is never declared
bugs.fix: Define windowMs = 2 minutes, keep the timestamps with now - t < windowMs, reject when 10 or more remain, otherwise push now.

bugs.test: rate limit blocks eleventh operation combined
bugs.why: the routes never use watchlistRateLimiter for add and remove
bugs.fix: watchlistRouter.post('/add', watchlistRateLimiter(), addToWatchlist) and the same for remove. Passing watchlistRateLimiter without calling it hangs the request.

edits.fixed:
watchlistRouter.post('/add', watchlistRateLimiter(), addToWatchlist);
watchlistRouter.post('/remove', watchlistRateLimiter(), removeFromWatchlist);
